name: H3 Adaptive Tail Cache
plain: A MiniMax H3 cache that always computes leading blocks and may skip the trailing portion, using sigma gap, a consecutive limit, and a content score from the warm-prefix output. The content limit adapts by an EMA of earlier scores. It also manages residuals on CPU or GPU with a safety margin.
math:
Tentative if in window, |σ−σ_last|<sigma_threshold(0.12), have residual, consecutive<max(2).
Probe δ = mean|c−p|/max(0.5(mean|c|+mean|p|),1e-5) on audio and video probes; score = (0.8δ_v+0.2δ_a)/1.0.
Allowed if score ≤ ceiling(0.75) and score ≤ max(floor .02, min(ceiling, EMA·1.25)). EMA decay .85. cache_depth .75 of blocks.
